strategy.overview: Q*Bert's Quest turns its center pyramid into a tug-of-war. Light all six cubes by making the currently useful rollovers and targets; Ugg, Wrongway, and Coily can erase that progress as their arrow tracks reach the pyramid. Hit the six yellow spot targets to push the villains back, and complete the full figure-eight loop to defeat the lit villain. Each completed pyramid adds end-of-ball value, while the operator can set the Special to light after five through eight completed pyramids.
strategy.simpleOverview: Build the six-cube pyramid with the lit rollovers and targets. Hit the six yellow spot targets to push Ugg, Wrongway, and Coily away from the pyramid, and make the full figure-eight loop to defeat the lit villain. Complete pyramids for end-of-ball bonus; the Special lights after the operator-set number of pyramids.
strategy.summary: Keep the pyramid moving faster than the villain tracks: finish useful lit switches, use the yellow spots before a villain reaches the cubes, and take the full figure-eight when it can remove the active threat.

quickInfo.name: Push Back Villains
quickInfo.summary: Hit the six yellow spot targets.

quickInfo.name: Light Special
quickInfo.summary: Complete the operator-set number of pyramids.

steps.text: Shoot the lit rollovers and target groups that add cubes to the six-space center pyramid.
Watch the Ugg, Wrongway, and Coily arrow tracks; hit yellow spot targets before a villain reaches the pyramid and removes cubes.
Complete the entire figure-eight loop when the active villain is in a position the installed setting allows you to defeat.
Finish the pyramid, then repeat; the configured Special threshold is five, six, seven, or eight completed pyramids.

alternatives.title: Protect a nearly complete pyramid
alternatives.when: Use this when only one or two cubes remain but a villain is close to the center.

steps.text: Hit a yellow spot target to buy space from the approaching villain.
Return immediately to the lit cube-building switch instead of starting another figure-eight attempt.
Reach the operator-set five-, six-, seven-, or eight-pyramid threshold to light Special.

machineSetup: Check whether the figure-eight defeats a villain from any position or only the first position, and confirm the five-through-eight-pyramid Special threshold.
Test the six pyramid lamps, all yellow spot targets, the complete figure-eight switch path, villain arrow lamps, and the unusual crossed flipper pairs.

techniques.name: Flipper Staging
techniques.instruction: Learn which two flippers each cabinet button moves before attempting the crossing loop; the reversed pairs can change which flipper reaches the ball first.

cautions.issue: The figure-eight villain rule and the pyramid threshold are adjustable.
cautions.response: Confirm both settings before planning a long pyramid run.
